units.translation: There are four Greek forms of this name: the first and most common Δαρεῖος [Dareios], the second Δαριαῖος [Dariaios], usually written Δαρειαῖος [Dareiaios] by scribes, in Xen. H. Gr. 2, 1, 8 and 9 and in the excerpts from Ctesias in Photius Bibl. p. 38-43, the third Δαριήκης [Dariēkēs], which Strabo 16 p. 785 mentions, the fourth Δαριάν [Darian] (with the middle syllable shortened), which Aeschylus used three times,
where Aa-ρεῖος Μ [Dareios M], but the meter demands what I restored as Δαριάν [Darian],

as I corrected what is in M: οἷον (οἶον schol.) ἄνακτα δαρεῖὰν ἠé [such a lord Darian or], where the schol. says ἔοικε δὲ ὁ Δαρεῖος καὶ Δαρειὰν λέγεσθαι [it seems that Dareios is also called Dareian], but foolishly adding ἢ τὴν Δαρείαν ψυχὴν ἀνάπεμψον [or send up the soul of Dareia].
where M in the second place has δαρειάν [Dareian], but in the first correctly δαριάν [Darian], although changed by a corrector to δαρειάν [Dareian].
it seems that Dareios is also called Dareian
or send up the soul of Dareia
But not for a long time will the father leave it desolate.
Why does she remain a virgin for long?
For he will not rule the gods for long.
where the schol. explains it by δασύτριχον [thick-haired].
For the thick and shady paths of the mind extend.
a fiery, very thick, shady beard,
visions of dream phantoms, distributors of ancestral wealth.
Bitter Ares is a bad distributor of wealth.
For Δαυλίς [Daulis] or Δαυλία [Daulia] was a city of Phocis.
I am a stranger, a Daulian from Phocis.

where the schol. says: πυκνοὶ γάρ εἰσιν οἱ τῶν πραπίδων αὐτοῦ τοῦ Διὸς πόροι [for the paths of the mind of Zeus himself are dense]. Eustathius p. 274, 24 1654, 27 noted that Pausanias approved the accent δαῦλος [daulos]. It is written with an acute accent by Herodian in Arcad. p. 53, 6.
shaggy is his mustache and the base of his beard.

burning the bloody firebrand of her child, of the same age,
